formal_benchmark_reason: grouped dataset split and collection release are separate
mechanism: oslo.service 4.3.0 removes the private oslo_service.backend.threading package path used by Heat, so importing Heat's engine service during target test discovery fails
repair_template: replace the removed private dependency import with oslo.service's public threadgroup API and initialize the test backend explicitly

semantic_review.a1_failure: With oslo.service 4.3.0 installed against the unchanged opening-cutoff Heat snapshot, the pre-existing service-engine command fails during discovery because heat.engine.service imports the removed oslo_service.backend.threading path. With 4.2.2 the command runs 13 tests successfully, and the exact target patch restores all 13 under 4.3.0. The exclusive stable signature is ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'oslo_service.backend.threading'.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Reviewed the one-pin source opening diff, exact maintainer target diff, cutoff tox.ini command provenance, installed-version probes proving oslo.service 4.2.2/4.3.0/4.3.0, patch applicability, and all arm logs. Every arm used the same pre-existing stestr selector; A0 and A2 ran all 13 selected tests, while A1 failed at target-module discovery on the removed dependency path. The patch deletes or skips no tests.
semantic_review.source_effect: The source opening changes exactly one upper-constraints pin, oslo.service 4.2.2 to 4.3.0; version 4.3 removes the private backend.threading module path while retaining threadgroup through a public import.
semantic_review.target_repair: The exact maintainer patch applies to the public opening-cutoff Heat snapshot, changes production code to import the public oslo_service.threadgroup API, and explicitly initializes the threading backend in the existing test base. Its tox lint adjustment follows the new import ordering; no target test is deleted, skipped, or replaced.
